units.source_text: 驹子总是避而不谈行男的事。

en.t: Komako always avoided talking about Yukio.

units.source_text: 即使不是未婚夫妻，但为了给他赚一笔疗养费，不惜在这里当艺妓，那无疑也是一件“认真严肃的事情”吧。

en.t: Even if they were not engaged, the fact that she had gone so far as to work here as a geisha to earn money for his convalescence was surely a “serious and earnest matter.”
